Title: Global Operations Specialist
Job Description:
Company Description

Harvics Global Ventures is a category-focused FMCG brand and supply platform specializing in developing proprietary brands and structured private-label programs for regulated wholesale and retail markets. The company operates as a brand owner, scaling innovative FMCG brands, and as a private-label and supply partner, ensuring compliance and consistent execution. Harvics emphasizes accountability, disciplined operations, and sustainable growth, pursuing category expansion driven by commercial viability and operational readiness. The company leverages established supply chains to empower market entry, brand growth, and long-term retail success, with a strategy that prioritizes execution and commercial clarity.

Role Description

This is a full-time, on-site role for a Global Operations Specialist based in Paris. The Global Operations Specialist will oversee and streamline global operations, ensuring the company’s supply and process goals are met efficiently. Responsibilities include managing operations workflows, analyzing business processes, optimizing supply chain activities, coordinating with stakeholders across regions, and addressing operational challenges while providing support to finance and compliance teams.

Qualifications
  • Proven expertise in Global Operations and Operations Management to handle supply chain processes efficiently and improve execution strategies.
  • Strong Analytical Skills to evaluate business processes, monitor performance metrics, and implement data-driven improvements.
  • Excellent Communication skills to collaborate with cross-functional teams and engage stakeholders across different regions effectively.
  • Sound understanding of Finance to support budget management, cost analysis, and ensure financial alignment with operational goals.
  • Experience in compliance management and working within regulated markets is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, or related fields; Advanced degrees or certifications are a bonus.
  • Demonstrated ability to work on-site in a fast-paced global environment, meeting deadlines and maintaining high standards of accountability.
